import sys
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/tmp/tests')
from harness import run, t, done

# future overbooking witness: lease [10,20) rate 5 on link0 (cap 10); shrink to 3
load = {'op':'load','n':2,'links':[[0,1,10]],
        'bookings':[{'id':'b','owner':'o','window':[10,20],'envelope':[[0,5]]}]}
r = run([load, {'op':'edit','rev':0,'changes':[[0,3]],'force':False}])
t('future blocked', r[1], {'status':'blocked','rev':0,'link':0,'time':10,'used':5,'capacity':3})

# equal capacity with force -> no revocation
r = run([load, {'op':'edit','rev':0,'changes':[[0,10]],'force':True}])
t('force equal no revoke', r[1], {'status':'ok','rev':1,'cancelled':[]})

# increase with force -> no revocation
r = run([load, {'op':'edit','rev':0,'changes':[[0,20]],'force':True}])
t('force increase no revoke', r[1], {'status':'ok','rev':1,'cancelled':[]})

# prepare s == now boundary ok
prep = {'op':'prepare','id':'p','owner':'a','window':[0,4],'period':4,
        'participants':[[0,1],[1,1]],'envelope':[[0,4]],'rev':0}
r = run([load, prep])
t('prep s==now', r[1]['status'], 'prepared')

# advance to exactly end expires
r = run([load, {'op':'advance','time':20}])
t('advance to end', r[1], {'status':'ok','rev':1,'now':20,'expired':['b']})
# advance one tick before end: still live
r = run([load, {'op':'advance','time':19}, {'op':'audit','at':[19]}])
t('not expired before end', r[2]['leases'], ['b'])

# window ending exactly at t expires at advance(t)
r = run([load, {'op':'advance','time':10}])
t('start time active', r[1], {'status':'ok','rev':1,'now':10,'expired':[]})

# edit blocked only in far future beyond any lease -> no block
load2 = {'op':'load','n':2,'links':[[0,1,10]],'bookings':[]}
r = run([load2, {'op':'edit','rev':0,'changes':[[0,0]],'force':False}])
